initial_application: No prior commit on the combined issue-reconcile branch carried Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-32049, and git history did not show a FHIR-32049-tagged source commit. additional_context: Procedure is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, owned by Patient Care, and marked approved. FHIR versions.html defines FMM 6 as synonymous with normative standards status. September 2025 Patient Care minutes and March 2026 Patient Care call material support the normative-resource maturity handling, and a Zulip maturity-comment thread supports resolving old maturity comments based on the intended normative direction. reconciliation: Changed source/fhir.ini [fmm] procedure from 4 to 6 and source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml structuredefinition-fmm from 3 to 6. No terminology artifacts, search parameters, examples, or generated output were changed because the Jira request is specifically resource-level maturity metadata.
